text:
maria: I opened a small PR to update the SDK quickstart snippets for Node/TS — mainly reorder + one option rename. Can someone take a quick look? PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/3421 :pray:

docs-bot: Preview build available: https://deploy-preview-3421--docs.redwood.ai/quickstart (auto-preview)

kevin: I can in ~30m. quick question — does the new snippet require Node 18+? we should call that out if so.

maria: good call. no runtime change, just a small reorder + option rename. snippet below:
```js
import { RedwoodClient } from '@redwood/inference';
const client = new RedwoodClient();
const res = await client.generate({ model: 'redwood-alpha', prompt: 'Hello' });
console.log(res.text);
```

sam: quick nit — show a `max_tokens` example and the SDK shape is `res.output` in v0.5. suggestion:
```js
const res = await client.generate({ model: 'redwood-alpha', prompt, max_tokens: 256 });
console.log(res.output);
```
LGTM once that tiny change is in.

maria: thanks — updated to include `max_tokens` and `res.output` in the latest commit (pushed).

jen: Is it safe to merge before tomorrow's onboarding? I'd like the updated quickstart for the workshop slides.

kevin: I'll approve after a quick pass. if sam's nit is addressed, ok to merge. ping me after CI. :thumbsup:

maria: CI is green now. @kevin can you approve when you have a sec?

kevin: Approved and merged. :rocket:
